summary: Full-stack testing pass for RideAtlas. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passing across auth, all CRUD resources, fuel mileage computation, stats summary, and data isolation. Frontend: end-to-end Playwright flow verified — landing → register → dashboard (auto-authed with cookie+localStorage token) → reload persists auth via /api/auth/me → Garage add bike → Trip Planner create + Leaflet map + polyline/markers → Fuel Log 2 entries with computed_mileage 30 km/L → Service, Expenses, Journal, Packing add all worked → Statistics renders with charts and achievements → logout returns to / and /dashboard redirects to /login → re-login works.

issues: 'Distance by month' chart X-axis labels (e.g. 02..07) reflect the server's clock-derived 6-month window rather than the current month claimed in the environment (Jan 2026). Not a functional bug — depends on real server UTC time.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~590 lines — acceptable for MVP but nearing the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting routers per resource as the codebase grows.

CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router(api). This still works in FastAPI/Starlette because middleware is applied at request time regardless of registration order, but the conventional order is to add middleware before mounting routes for clarity.
Auth cookie uses SameSite=None; Secure=True — correct for cross-site preview URLs. Good.
No brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions 5-fail lockout). Not implemented but not requested in review either — flagging for awareness.
seed_admin / demo user creation not implemented; test_credentials.md references demo@rideatlas.com but that account is never seeded. Fresh registration works fine; demo login would fail.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in favor of FastAPI lifespan — non-blocking, but worth modernizing.
All list endpoints exclude _id in projection — good. All resource endpoints correctly filter by user_id — data isolation verified via test.
test_credentials: test_credentials.md references demo@rideatlas.com / demo1234 but no seed logic exists in backend; that account does NOT exist. Tests use freshly-registered accounts with @example.com domain (backend rejects @rideatlas.test as a reserved TLD per email-validator).
seed_data_creation: None. Each test registers ephemeral users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run via: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Use @example.com for test emails (backend email-validator rejects .test TLD). Backend lowercases emails on register/login. Auth accepts either httpOnly cookie 'access_token' or Bearer header. Demo user demo@rideatlas.com is NOT seeded — register new users in tests. All 8 resource routers work; fuel computed_mileage requires two entries with increasing odometer on same bike_id (null bike_id is a valid grouping).
